mutants.name: agent-owns-root-ignores-root
mutants.why: _agent_owns_root delegates to _agent_loaded and ignores root; any loaded agent makes any dashboard kickstart, reproducing thread 297; t10 asserts kickstart is NOT called for a foreign root

r = _agent_root(label)

mutants.name: kickstart-always-replace
mutants.why: dropping the replace flag and always emitting -k means a kickstart that follows a free lock replaces an incumbent that does not exist, reproducing the drain race; t12 asserts -k is absent when replace=False

mutants.name: agent-root-no-program-fallback
mutants.why: dropping the program fallback means _agent_root returns None when the working-directory line is absent; t8 case 2 asserts the fallback derives the root from the program path

mutants.name: spawn-child-replace-true
mutants.why: _spawn_child passing replace=True kickstarts with -k and can kill an incumbent daemon; t11 asserts replace=False is passed when the agent owns this root

mutants.name: agent-owns-root-basename-only
mutants.why: comparing basename rather than realpath makes a dashboard on tmp/other/bellows think it owns the agent whose root is tmp/bellows (same basename, different parent); t9 asserts the comparison is False for a different parent
mutants.anchor: return r is not None and os.path.realpath(r) == os.path.realpath(str(root))
mutants.replacement: return r is not None and os.path.basename(r) == os.path.basename(str(root))
